# Ten proposed methods and their evidence

**Zero of ten demonstrates a strong spec-level win.** This retrospective selection covers ten different P-series questions with scored external comparisons, including predictive ML and federated learning. Selection occurred after results were visible. Each row uses one experiment, with development studies identified explicitly. Several measure proxies for the intended application. The revised target of three strong wins and seven ties or better remains unmet. Venue tier is a submission aspiration.

“Strong” requires the original all-comparator practical and uncertainty gates on the intended held-out task. “Small” describes a positive observed difference against the best control below a practical threshold or without statistical support. “Equivalent” would require a justified two-sided tolerance and paired uncertainty within it, or a proof over a specified finite domain. “Undetermined” includes ties confined to a sample. Observed losses are reported explicitly. A superiority threshold alone supplies no scientific justification for an equivalence or noninferiority bound.

| ID and proposed method | Evaluation, strongest control and uncertainty | Judgment |
|---|---|---|
| P01 confidence gate with label rerouting | Future OULAD presentation, accuracy at matched acceptance. Maximum confidence selected the same 552 cases, with 350 correct for both. Paired learner bootstrap label-effect interval [0, 0] conditions on this fit and cohort. | Observed tie, population equivalence undetermined |
| P02 destination-specific forced-path contraction | MBTA development cancellations. Exact witnesses and 10% reductions in both latency measures, gross and amortized, required. Against signature-only repair p95 increased 17%. Timings on one network lack independent network uncertainty. | Observed loss |
| P04 weekly quiz distribution shift detector | Development, 15 offering transitions, two positives. AP .50 versus inventory 1.00. Requires .05 improvement and higher recall at FDP ≤.10. Shared modules preclude treating edges as independent. | Observed loss |
| P05 long-history next-response blend | ASSIST2015 held-out learner log loss. Short-history blend minus candidate .000137 nats, simultaneous interval [−.000078, .000352], practical target .015. | Small point gain |
| P06 robust review thresholds | Worst-group recall at fixed capacity. OULAD tied point thresholds. UCI quota led by .111, paired gain interval [−.214, 0]. Registered precision noninferiority versus unrestricted requires lower bound ≥−.01 on both datasets. OULAD bound −.01196 fails, UCI bound 0 passes. | Observed transfer loss, precision noninferiority undetermined across both |
| P10 pruned Boolean prerequisite composition | Development census of 1,914 eligible bundles in two tables. Same minimum addition count as exhaustive unpruned composition throughout. Removing a dominated superset preserves minimum union cardinality under further unions. Original one-course saving target addresses independent local repair. | Equivalent optimum on enumerated domain only |
| P11 disagreement-gated rubric blend | Development essay panel, ordinal score MAE. Gain over ungated blend .000071 points, interval [−.00240, .00216], target .05. | Small point gain |
| P12 multifeature heading lineage matcher | Development census of 21 labeled PEP renames. Full, body-omitted and context-omitted matchers each recovered 19. Edits can share documents. No population interval or registered equivalence tolerance. | Observed tie, equivalence undetermined |
| P13 federated local adaptation | Seven simulated university module clients, development. Macro AUC gain versus weak-ridge adaptation −.00588, simultaneous learner-cluster interval [−.03654, .02477]. Requires .02 gain and positive lower bound against every control. FedAvg alone would overstate performance. | Observed loss, direction uncertain |
| P14 accessibility outcome fusion | Held-out ACT rules, equal-rule exact accuracy. Gain .02168 over naive Bayes. Seven rule wins, four losses, 39 ties, Holm-adjusted sign-test p=.549. Positive gain and adjusted p<.05 required throughout. | Small point gain, superiority undetermined |

Only P06 supplies an explicit allowable inferiority bound for the endpoint tested here. The audit applies its existing paired precision intervals directly. No new post hoc equivalence tests were used. P10's finite result concerns repair size alone. Across the ten rows there are three small point gains, one finite-domain equivalence, two empirical ties and four observed losses. None establishes selection-adjusted portfolio-wide inference.

From the repository root, run `taskset -c 0-11 python research_v4_2/external/portfolio_audit/audit.py`. Compare stdout byte-for-byte with [saved output](portfolio_audit/results.json), which pins the input files by SHA-256. For protocols, dataset limitations and gaps between measured and specified tasks see the [specification crosswalk](SPEC_COVERAGE.md) and [study evidence register](SUPERIORITY.md).

## Subsequent tests

On [14 previously reserved CSPLib curricula](curriculum_plan/term_requests/confirmation/README.md), P10 interval filtering gained 17.77% in service time against unfiltered CP-SAT, but only 0.90% against precedence-narrowed CP-SAT, with an interval spanning zero. All six policies exhausted the fixed budget on one request. On [nine Sphinx files](catalog_revisions/lineage/transfer/README.md), P12 order alignment recovered 10 of 13 renames and body overlap recovered 13. In [P05 EdNet development](knowledge_tracing/distractors/README.md), the option-history model improved on the strongest clock control by .000397 nats and missed its .015 margin. [P13 federated Newton updates](landmark/federated/sufficient_stats/README.md) reproduced pooled optimization on seven simulated clients and trailed weak-ridge adaptation in predictive AUC. These tests add zero strong wins.

[P01 enrollment covariates](coverage/conditional_error/README.md) increased worst-course error by 1.30 percentage points versus the matched selector. The [P13 module sensitivity analysis](landmark/federated/manuscript.md) found that neural half-transfer led under each of the seven omissions. The [P10 manuscript](curriculum_plan/manuscript.md) reports the held-out scheduling result alongside its prerequisite-repair study. None changes the count of strong wins.

[P06 boosted scores](allocation/joint/boosted/README.md) left the original absolute precision floor infeasible in both development cohorts. [P11 intermediate reader judgments](rater_agreement/decision_paths/README.md) improved Brier loss relative to conditioning on the first binary vote alone. The additional gain from smoothing over unregularized path counts remains uncertain on the 770 eligible items. This is an anonymous short-answer annotation task.

[P10 probing](curriculum_plan/term_requests/probe_service/README.md) resolved 448 of 448 timetable requests in a follow-up where the matched interval service resolved 447. It required 7.33% more service time and missed the practical speed gate.
